context: The skill should help write new Optional code by choosing the boundary before branches and preserving lazy cache mutation.

checklist.name: Chooses Optional boundary
checklist.description: Uses cache.find(key) or equivalent Optional-returning lookup as the present/absent boundary.

checklist.name: Lazy creation
checklist.description: Uses orElseGet(() -> createAndStore(key)) or an equivalent explicit absent branch so document creation and cache mutation are lazy.

checklist.name: No eager fallback
checklist.description: Does not use orElse(createAndStore(key)) or otherwise create/store the document when the cache already has it.

checklist.name: No Optional antipattern workaround
checklist.description: Does not use isPresent() plus get(), orElse(null), or an Optional-to-list workaround.
